optimization.background_parameters: all original trainable parameters in both branches

notes: RT-inspired thin 3D Gaussian planar surfaces; not official RT-Splatting reproduction.
Pseudo-mask positives are hypotheses; outside pixels are not negative glass supervision.
Both branches reuse the same baseline and optimizer state, camera order, photometric objective and additional iteration count.
Equal iterations are not equal runtime: the surface branch has extra rendering and parameters.
Only validation decides adoption. Cam19 is evaluated after the decision; earlier baseline previews already included cam19.
Thresholds are predeclared engineering starting values, not paper-derived or calibrated glass-detection accuracy.
